hints.title: Small Column Dimension
hints.text: Because the number of columns is at most 5, a valid subset of size 1 or 2 is always sufficient if any valid subset exists.

hints.title: Bitmask Encoding
hints.text: Encode each row into an integer bitmask based on its column values.

hints.title: Disjoint Mask Search
hints.text: Check if a row of all zeros exists, or find any two rows whose bitwise intersection is zero.

hints.title: Bitwise Subset Extraction

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exponential subset generation across m rows is intractable; bounding subset size to 2 suffices.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Map holds at most 32 mask occurrences.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Proves mathematically that a good subset of size 1 or 2 always exists if any exists.
